operator_statement:
I accept the Cycle-005 acquisition apparatus at companion digest `sha256:073c7ff2d5acb6db548bddd34e34de4e65eaeaaff31a6051cdc05ccfddb8e4c6`, containing 23 assets.

Supersession. This acceptance supersedes the apparatus identity `sha256:115a8cdf20ce63e29064277330ad97387d48bdd353bef392f8d06424d76fa4bb` (20 assets) and, through it, `sha256:dc850ff1abdc53f45163eb93c772c2d36bd0e7dcf32eda18c7e3f963fc3a0a92`. The prior Gate-A acceptance record `sha256:29b4dd8f97815985ce9156f6b384deaf788ca843d4a1ff51d16f1d7b3b34f640` is not rewritten, withdrawn or amended: it has been preserved byte-for-byte at `lab/evidence/cycle-005/gate-a-acceptance-superseded-29b4dd8f.json` and stands unaltered as valid point-in-time evidence of the decisions I made on 2026-07-24. It no longer governs contact authority. This record is the governing Gate-A authority from now on.

Basis of supersession. The 20-asset apparatus carried defect M1, under which the first authorized contact would have typed a benign USGS catalog response as a contamination event. The remediation at reports 16-23 corrected M1 and four further authority defects (F1, C-1/C-5/C-6, R-1, R-4) and was audited to AUDIT_PASS at report 24. Sprint-5 Task 2.2 then landed the pre-contact pin-invariance boundary and the production composition root, and report 31 audited the whole result to AUDIT_PASS at this identity.

Scope of the accepted apparatus. The accepted 23-asset identity now includes the Task-2.2 pre-contact pin-invariance boundary (`lab/resolution/pin-invariance.js`, the production `io.preparePinInvariance` for the `g0` event; the `FROZEN_PIN_ASSET_COUNT` and split `ONE_SHOT_SCOPE` in `lab/acquisition/acquire.js`) and the production composition root `lab/driver/acquire-run.js`, with `lab/driver` added to the apparatus namespaces. The FR-E3 pin-invariance artifact is persisted and verified before first transport, the entry-point one-shot set includes it while the internal pool-entry set excludes it, and an interruption after persistence blocks restart and routes to operator adjudication rather than silent resume. The execution vehicle for Cycle-005 contact is therefore the pinned apparatus itself, reached through the pinned driver; no unpinned contact controller exists.

I have confirmed that no scientific method, measurement referent, authored gate input, or candidate eligibility determination was altered by any of this: `method-set.json`, the frozen route table, `classify.js`, `extract.js`, `assemble.js` and the remaining `lab/resolution/` modules are unchanged. My prior scientific decisions therefore carry forward intact.

UD-1 - history_years. I accept the class-(ii) documented-span method for all five candidates: history_years = (end_ms - start_ms) / YEAR_MS, YEAR_MS = 365.25 x 86,400,000, conservative for the >= 3-year gate. I pin the referents as follows: ranks 1 and 2 use the single site or station named pre-contact in G0; rank 3 uses the deployment period if present on the declared surface, otherwise class 3; rank 4 uses the product-level network-union span across `isd-history.csv` as currently implemented; rank 5 uses the series period of record. I have confirmed that `extract.js` and the route table are unchanged, so "as currently implemented" denotes the same code it denoted at the prior acceptance.

UD-1 - n_observations. I accept class 3 for ranks 1-4 under this apparatus.

For rank 1, I acknowledge that USGS `count_nu` may support a conservative bound, but I do not accept it this cycle because its series semantics are insufficiently documented and its result depends on a site that has not yet been pinned. This is carried forward to the next preregistration cycle.

For ranks 2 and 3, no lawful documented aggregate-count surface was found.

For rank 4, I acknowledge that `isd-inventory.csv` provides an exact documented observation count. I deliberately do not add that surface to Cycle-005 because it is outside the accepted apparatus, would require a new route, identity, and contamination-guard assessment, and cannot change the frozen FR-D2 outcome. Rank 4 is therefore unresolved under this accepted apparatus, not because no lawful external surface exists. I have confirmed the route table is byte-identical, so that surface remains outside the apparatus at this identity.

I accept EIA's class-(i) count method as lawful as written but do not authorize its exercise in Cycle-005.

DR-8. I accept the authored gate inputs for all five candidates as represented in the accepted method set, including EIA `exogenous: false`. I have confirmed `method-set.json` is byte-identical to the version I accepted previously. I acknowledge the partial authored-source citation coverage and accept it as a non-blocking limitation. I acknowledge that the content-addressed method set retains `PROPOSED-PENDING-GATE-A`, and that this Gate-A acceptance record - not the superseded one - is the governing authority for its accepted status.

UD-2. I leave EIA uncredentialed for Cycle-005. It must be recorded as class 3 with the reason `UD-2 credential posture: uncredentialed by operator decision` - never "endpoint unavailable". No EIA credential is authorized. I note that this posture is mechanically enforced: all four authorized routes carry `credential: null`, `FORGE_EIA_API_KEY` is never read on the authorized path, and a credentialed route authorized under an uncredentialed posture is refused.

Expected outcome. I acknowledge that the frozen FR-D2 outcome-invariance test cannot seal a result under this accepted apparatus and that Cycle-005 is expected to end in PRD disposition B - acquisition-unresolved. I accept that as a valid, scientifically honest, non-failing outcome. I note that the M1 remediation restores the reachability of that sub-type, which under the superseded 20-asset apparatus would in practice have been displaced by a contamination-halt on the first contact. This is an acknowledgment only; the terminal disposition is determined by the S02 chain head, not by this record.

Residual disclosures. I acknowledge finding D-A (report 31 section 4) as deferred runtime hardening and non-blocking: the runtime seatbelt is closed under modification of a pinned asset but not under addition of an unenumerated one. I accept the audit's bounding of it - the supported production path's static import closure is complete (19 modules, zero dynamic imports anywhere in the three namespaces), an added file is unreachable from that path, manifest reconstruction moves the identity, and five compensating controls were verified live. Closing it by walking the namespace roots in `selfVerifyAcquisitionManifest` is later work and does not gate this acceptance.

I further acknowledge, as present, unchanged and non-material at this identity: F-A1, four static-closure leaf modules (`src/receipt/canonicalize.js`, `src/receipt/hash.js`, `src/ingester/generic.js`, `src/replay/deterministic.js`) covered by git tracking and CI rather than by a pin - the ordinary bootstrap limit of hash-based self-verification, pre-existing and not widened by this sprint; D-B, the `from`-form-only import lints, with nil live impact because no dynamic import or `createRequire` exists in the three namespaces; D-C.2, `lab/resolution/select.js` rendering as binary to `git diff` (NUL at offset 1443) which blinds the human-review control for that one pinned asset; D-C, the deliberate NUL bytes in `routes.js` and `acquisition-cli.spec.js`, with all 23 assets verified UTF-8-lossless; D-1, the `pin-invariance.js` G9 docstring saying "one-way" where the lint is bidirectional, a documentation defect with no executable consequence; A-1, the query-parameter equivalence finding, unreachable under the frozen scope since no pinned identifier contains "=", the only value naturally carrying arbitrary bytes is the excluded EIA `api_key`, and the consequence is fail-closed rather than exposure; R-2 reserved-character percent-encoding equivalence, of which A-1 is a concrete instance; the empty-userinfo redirect delimiters, verified inert; R-3, `redirect_refused` discarding the received HTTP status; C-2, the fixed `halt-1.json` allocation in a shared namespace, narrowed but not closed; C-3, the pre-first-append interruption window, now bounded by the Task-2.2 boundary; C-4 and F-5, the `timeout` label covering transport errors; F-4, `acquire.js` importing read-only APIs from `lab/harness/manifests.js` within the G9 fence; F-6, `scope.route_classes` not validated against the frozen class set, confirmed inert because over-declaring cannot authorize anything; D-2, the `acquirePool` pool-entry gate not seeing an interrupted run's pin artifact, bounded to direct `acquirePool` callers since the production path goes through `main`; D-4, the R-4 no-override lint not scanning `pin-invariance.js`, verified clean by hand; the quoted ISD-header uncertainty, which cannot reach a scientific input because ISD declares n_observations class iii and HARD_GATE_MEASURED requires both fields lawful; and A-2, the NUL bytes at `routes.js:363` which cause default text sweeps to skip a pinned apparatus asset and which require `grep -a` or a byte-level read.

I further acknowledge the accepted cost of the M1 correction: a provider prefixing genuine observation rows with "#" would evade the value-bearing scan on that surface. I accept this as bounded, because `extract.js` drops "#" lines from the same surface so no such value can enter a census input or a provenance row, G3 zero-persistence means the bytes are never written, and comment lines still count against the 5000-row inventory bound.

I also acknowledge the remaining process-level interruption limitation: an operator who deletes the FR-E3 pin-invariance artifact and re-runs is outside the apparatus's reach. The apparatus offers no override, resume flag or environment escape, and this residue is correctly disclosed rather than defended against.

Scope of this authorization. This statement authorizes preservation of the historical Gate-A record at the archival path and creation of this replacement Gate-A acceptance record only. It does not authorize G0 or any provider contact; it does not authorize any apparatus change; it does not authorize creation of any run-evidence or pin-invariance record, including `pin-invariance-g0.json` or a retroactive `pin-invariance-gate-a.json`; and it does not authorize any credential, pool edit, census selection, seal, or M5 work.
